solid rubber.source: Density from a measured 102.5 g, 60 mm superball: Cross, Am. J. Phys. 70, 482 (2002), a 60 mm superball on a hard wood floor.

hollow plastic.source: Polyethylene, 910 (LDPE) to 960 (HDPE) kg/m³ (Engineering ToolBox, Solids – Densities). Wall thickness provisional.

modeling clay.source: Density 1570 kg/m³ for Van Aken plasticine (Eckerson, Liechty and Sorensen, J. Strain Anal. Eng. Des., 2008). Yield strength: plasticine flow stress 0.08–0.175 MPa in compression (Sofuoglu and Rasty, Tribology International, 2000).

domino wood.source: Hardwood, as the table; its own material so domino-on-domino contact can differ from domino-on-table.

contacts.source: Restitution 0.86 (vertical, at 4.13 m/s) and static friction 0.52: Cross, Am. J. Phys. 70, 482 (2002), a 60 mm superball on a hard wood floor. Rolling resistance provisional (the Prism mechanics lab's calibration for a ball on wood). Sideways restitution e_x 0.49-0.76 and bounce grip >= 0.9: Cross, Am. J. Phys. 70, 482 and 1093 (2002); Garwin, Am. J. Phys. 37, 88 (1969).

Restitution: a hollow hard plastic ball dropped 92 cm onto concrete rebounded 43.6 cm, e = 0.69 (Bennett and Meepagala, The Physics Factbook, 2005). Friction: static, polyethylene on planed unfinished hemlock (Murase, J. Fac. Agr. Kyushu Univ. 28, 147, 1984). Rolling resistance provisional. Restitution 0.75 is that bounce with the engine's own air drag taken out. Sideways restitution 0.15 provisional (thin shells keep little sideways spring).
